title: Storm Ciarán — explosive deep low crossing the western Channel
notes: Ciarán underwent explosive cyclogenesis on 1 Nov 2023 and crossed Brittany/the Channel overnight 1-2 Nov; minimum central pressure ~953-954 hPa over the Channel (England's November low-pressure record). The 968 hPa threshold and 50N 0E +/-4 deg expectation are deliberately generous — the corpus validates the detector, not history trivia. Confidence: high (well-documented event).
